model_annotation:
The line graph shows the F1 scores of three systems in relation to training epochs. 

The x-axis, labeled "epoch(亿)", ranges from 0 to 18 with increments of 2 and is measured in units of hundred millions (亿). The y-axis, labeled "F1分数", spans from 0.5 to 0.9 with increments of 0.05.

The graph displays three lines: red for "lattice," blue for "FLAT," and orange for "OURS." The red line starts at approximately (3, 0.55) and increases to around (8, 0.65), then fluctuates slightly before ending at (18, 0.63). The blue line starts at (3, 0.75), increases to about (10, 0.78), and then decreases to (18, 0.72). The orange line starts at (3, 0.76), increases to around (6, 0.78), then decreases slightly to (18, 0.72).
